meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义 AI 该记住哪些内容,按领域打标签并推送提醒
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 按自己的领域习惯记住要点并在关键记忆上收到提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize what your assistant remembers, tag notes by domain, and fire alerts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to remember domain notes and alert you on key ones.

howto.what: 装好后它会先问你在做什么,再提议一套笔记类型和概念标签,经你确认后安装并启用成 claude-mem 自定义模式,可选择加 Telegram 提醒,最后重启 worker 并验证是否生效。
howto.when: 当你要求自定义 claude-mem 记住的内容、新建或修改模式、新增观察类型或标签等时触发,即使你没说出「模式」这个词。

say.text: 帮我做一个记录设计决策和客户偏好的自定义模式
say.note: 它会先问你几个问题,再给出分类方案

say.text: 我在做法律,想要一个能记案件规则和考点陷阱的模式
say.note: 它会据此提出观察类型和标签供你确认

say.text: 给这个模式加上 Telegram 提醒,只推 incident 这类观察
say.note: 会需要你另行同意完成 Telegram 凭据设置

howto.what_en: It interviews you, proposes a small set of observation types and concept tags, installs and activates your custom claude-mem mode, optionally sets up Telegram alerts, then restarts and verifies the worker.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, add observation types, tags, or Telegram alerts for certain memories—even if you never say "mode."

say_en.text: Make me a custom mode that records design decisions and client preferences
say_en.note: It asks a few questions before proposing a taxonomy

say_en.text: I work in law—give me a mode that notes case rules and exam traps
say_en.note: It proposes observation types and tags for your approval

say_en.text: Add Telegram alerts to this mode for incident observations only
say_en.note: You still approve the Telegram credential setup separately
